purpose: Index of all historical receipts, merged code commits, and readback sources used to establish staging recovery storage acceptance, coordinate verification, and rollout mapping.

permitted_actions: Read immutable existing foundation metadata and state receipts
Read immutable preflight, CI collection, and PR merge receipts
Verify code contracts, fail-closed prechecks, and workflow boundaries
Map historical criteria to current readiness and future rollout tasks
prohibited_actions: No reading secret versions, tokens, or plaintext keys
No reading raw Terraform binary state plans or signing keys
No creating, modifying, or deleting cloud resources or GCS buckets
No modifying IAM policy bindings or enabling GCP APIs
No running terraform init, plan, apply, import, or state commands against live cloud
No running gh variable set or releasing dispatch triggers
No modifying or deleting quarantined security state objects

key_deliverables: check_release_environment.py: ODP_STAGING_RECOVERY_BUNDLE_BUCKET presence check and state bucket separation guard
deploy-dev.yml: deploy and staging_closeout jobs wired to dedicated recovery bucket
test_release_environment_precheck.py: fail-closed rejection tests for identical bucket and placeholder bucket
